Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Technology & SaaS is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on product analytics, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. In Technology & SaaS the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: GDPR / privacy regimes shapes what data may move, activation loops dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
